shots.name: A quiet clearing
shots.notes: Give the audience time to notice the letter on the small rock.

shots.name: Something catches her eye
shots.notes: Walk around the mossy rock. Keep the camera drift gentle.

shots.name: The unexpected letter
shots.notes: Pause before reaching. The letter is the point of attention.

shots.name: A careful pickup
shots.notes: Hold the framing while the hand meets the letter.

shots.name: An invitation?
shots.notes: Close enough to see the eyes and the held letter.

shots.name: For me?
shots.notes: Let the surprised reaction land before the musical answer.

shots.name: Of course!
shots.notes: A happy reaction and a little magic.

shots.name: The story can begin
shots.notes: A relaxed wave, then reveal the whole felt set.

filmBrief.logline: A curious felt character finds an invitation waiting in a quiet woodland clearing.
filmBrief.notes: Warm handmade felt. Calm camera moves. An obstacle-aware walk, a careful pickup, a surprised pause, then delight. The character changes pose at 12 fps while the camera renders at 30 fps. Music and cues remain on a continuous clock.
